definitions: A wide variety of names, often used to refer to someone who has been called many different things, usually in anger or frustration.
A comprehensive list of names, often implying that all possible names have been considered or used.
examples: When he crashed the car, his dad called him every name in the book.
She was so upset, she called him every name in the book.
The coach called the referee every name in the book after the controversial call.
